verdict.rationale: Windows has a documented official CLI, PowerShell, with a scripting overview, which supports scripted automation. A hands-on report describes setting up a CI system on Windows Server 2019. However, nothing in the evidence documents true headless operation (e.g., GUI-less installs or unattended CI runner configuration). One community report also says forced updates and random restarts made Windows 10 unacceptable on 24/7 test rigs. Missing for 10: first-party docs on headless/GUI-less operation, documented CI runner or unattended-automation setup, control over forced restarts during unattended runs, and in-depth corroboration of the CLI's automation coverage.
